summary: Silynxcom Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $1,300,000 of ordinary shares through ThinkEquity LLC under a sales agreement dated October 1, 2026. Sales occur at market prices via Rule 415; the agent receives a 3.0% commission. Shares trade on NYSE American under SYNX; last sale on October 1, 2026 was $0.98. Non-affiliate market value was about $4.02 million using 6,634,400 shares outstanding and 3,723,666 non-affiliate shares. No escrow applies. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
